title: WebRTC godot demo project is broken -  Parse message failed
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4RC1
Not reproducible in 4.3 stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc1 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6614) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads)

### Issue description

This seems to be breaking for projects that use this rtc impl and therefore they CANNOT be upgraded to 4.4RC1.

I can't establish the rtc connection in the webrtc project, the process results in the following issue with the internal server as well as with the nodejs based server:

```
Parse message failed from peer 925297947
Disconnected: 1000: 
[Signaling] Server disconnected: 1000 - 
Parse message failed from peer 1112564215
Disconnected: 1000: 
[Signaling] Server disconnected: 1000 - 
```

The project works flawlessly in 4.3 stable.


### Steps to reproduce

1. download the webrtc demo project:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/networking/webrtc_signaling

2. unpack the webrtc lib in the project:
https://github.com/godotengine/webrtc-native/releases

3. load and upgrade the project to 4.4, run the uid generator as requested by the engine

4. start the project and press listen or start the included node server in the server_node folder

5. press start in any of the instances, you can also try multiple debug windows

The Parse message failed error will occur and the Server will disconnect.

Note: I have not tried the webrtc minimal project.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

1. download the webrtc demo project:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/networking/webrtc_signaling

2. unpack the webrtc lib in the project:
https://github.com/godotengine/webrtc-native/releases
